_comment: Severity and corrective-action policy table. Status: CONSERVATIVE DEFAULTS — reviewed=false. Review and set reviewed=true when calibrated to your specific product and process.
_format: Each key is a DefectType value. 'severity' sets the base severity level. 'corrective_action' is a Python str.format() template; available variables: {component}, {observed}, {expected}. The '_default' entry is used when a defect type is not listed.

MISSING_COMPONENT.corrective_action: Component {component} is absent. Fit the component per the assembly drawing. Do not advance to the next stage until re-inspection passes.

WRONG_COMPONENT.corrective_action: Wrong component at {component} (found: {observed}; required: {expected}). Remove the incorrect part, fit the correct component, and re-inspect. Do not advance to the next stage.

SHIFTED_COMPONENT.corrective_action: Component {component} is out of position ({observed}; tolerance {expected}). Reposition the component within tolerance and re-inspect before advancing.

ROTATED_COMPONENT.corrective_action: Component {component} is incorrectly oriented ({observed}; tolerance {expected}). Correct the orientation and re-inspect before advancing.

SIZE_DEVIATION.corrective_action: Component {component} shows a size deviation ({observed}; expected {expected}). Confirm the correct part is fitted and re-inspect.

UNEXPECTED_COMPONENT.corrective_action: Unexpected component found at or near {component} ({observed}). Remove the extra part and re-inspect.

VISUAL_ANOMALY.corrective_action: Visual anomaly at {component} ({observed}). Inspect manually against the reference image. If damage, contamination, or a wrong part is confirmed, escalate to rework.

_default.corrective_action: Defect detected at {component}: {observed}. Inspect manually against the reference image and document findings.
